features.description: PM-tool category contract + Linear reference mapping. DontPanic owns a PM-tool category contract: abstract PMIssue / PMProject / PMStatus / PMComment Pydantic models + per-service mapping config schema + sync hook points (read by lock, write by close). Each PM tool supplies (a) a PP-generated MCP adapter (from P10 F001/F003 — already exists for Linear) AND (b) a small semantic mapping config at `~/.dontpanic/adapters/<service>.json` that translates the service's field names + status enum to the abstract contract. No DontPanic core code is added per service unless the category contract itself expands. Linear from P10 F003 becomes the reference implementation wired to the contract. v0 deliberately defines the minimum surface that ALL PM tools share — issue+project+status+comment. Service-specific concepts (Linear cycles, Jira epics, Monday boards) are NOT in the abstraction; they ship via the raw MCP adapter only and surface as opaque pass-throughs.
steps: Read P10 F001's SKILL.md + ADAPTER_TEMPLATE.md + the Linear adapter (when P10 F003 lands). Map exactly where the category contract attaches to the existing PP wrapper pattern.

Define abstract Pydantic models in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/integrations/pm_tool_models.py: PMIssue, PMProject, PMStatus (enum: backlog|active|in_progress|done|cancelled), PMComment. Frozen dataclass-style. v0 minimum field set only — do not include service-specific fields.

Define mapping config Pydantic model in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/integrations/pm_tool_mapping.py: field_name_map (PMIssue.title -> linear_issue.title), status_enum_map (Linear 'In Progress' -> PMStatus.active), priority_map (optional). Validator rejects mappings with missing status enum values + duplicates.

Define sync hook interface scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/integrations/pm_tool_sync.py: read_issue(uri) -> PMIssue, push_status(uri, new_status, dry_run=False) -> ExternalSyncRecord. Pure stdlib + Pydantic; per-service adapter implements these by composing the raw MCP adapter from P10.

Wire Linear adapter (from P10 F003) to the contract: create scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/integrations/linear_pm_tool.py that implements read_issue + push_status on top of the Linear MCP binary. Status enum map authored at ~/.dontpanic/adapters/linear.json (operator-provided; example placeholder committed to evidence/linear-mapping-example.json with placeholder tokens).

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_pm_tool_contract_f001.py: PMIssue round-trip; mapping config validation (happy + missing status + duplicate enum); read_issue happy path with mocked Linear MCP; push_status dry-run produces ExternalSyncRecord with status=pending + no real write. >=10 cases.

Document the category extension pattern in evidence/pm-tool-extension-guide.md: how to add Jira / Aha / Monday / GitHub Projects (PP-generate the MCP binary; author mapping JSON; create a thin wrapper module per the Linear example).
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check.
features.acceptance: (1) scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/integrations/pm_tool_{models,mapping,sync}.py exist + are Pydantic-validated. (2) linear_pm_tool.py implements read_issue + push_status against the Linear MCP adapter from P10 F003. (3) evidence/linear-mapping-example.json committed with placeholder tokens; sanitization clean. (4) test_pm_tool_contract_f001.py has >=10 cases including read_issue mock + push_status dry-run. (5) evidence/pm-tool-extension-guide.md explains how to add a second PM tool with mapping-only changes + per-service wrapper module ≤100 lines. (6) NO Linear-specific code in pm_tool_models.py / pm_tool_mapping.py / pm_tool_sync.py — Linear lives only in linear_pm_tool.py + the mapping JSON. (7) Full sweep at or above lock-time baseline.

features.description: Plan external_refs + one-way sync layer with durable evidence. New plan.md frontmatter array field `external_refs[]` with elements `{kind: pm_issue, uri: linear://issue/ABC-123, sync: none|push_status}`. `dontpanic plan lock` validates each ref points at a real upstream entity via the category adapter (one read per ref; cached). `dontpanic plan close` walks refs with `sync: push_status` and pushes DontPanic status flip via the category adapter's push_status hook. EVERY push attempt — success, failure, or skipped — produces a durable evidence record at `evidence/external_sync.json` with `{ref_uri, kind, attempted_at, status: pending|pushed|failed|skipped, response, error}`. Failures NEVER block plan close, BUT they MUST produce a `status: failed` evidence record — silent warning is a defect. Adds `dontpanic plan resync <plan-id>` for retrying failed pushes. `--dry-run` flag on plan close shows the intended external write payload without executing.
steps: Bump plan.schema.json (agent-conventions) to add optional external_refs array field. Subtree pull into DontPanic claude/shared/. Bump VERSION accordingly.
Add Pydantic model ExternalRef + ExternalSyncRecord to plan_loader. Validate kind enum, uri format, sync enum at parse time.

Wire `dontpanic plan lock` to validate each external_ref via category adapter read_issue. Cache per-uri for re-locks (TTL: session-scoped). Lock fails loud if a ref's uri is unreachable AND sync=push_status (push targets must exist); refs with sync=none can be unreachable without blocking.

Wire `dontpanic plan close` to walk external_refs with sync=push_status, call push_status(uri, mapped_status, dry_run=args.dry_run), write evidence/external_sync.json record per attempt. Multiple refs: write multi-element array; partial failures produce mixed array but DO NOT block plan close.
Add `dontpanic plan resync <plan-id>` CLI: re-reads evidence/external_sync.json, retries any `status: failed|pending` entries via the category adapter. Idempotent (already-pushed entries skipped).
Add `--dry-run` flag to `dontpanic plan close`. Prints intended push payloads + writes evidence/external_sync.json with status=pending; does NOT call the category adapter's real push_status.

Add fixture tests in scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_external_refs_sync_f002.py: schema validation (valid + missing kind + bad uri + bad sync enum); lock validates ref reachable; lock allows unreachable ref when sync=none; close pushes status + writes pushed evidence; close handles push failure with failed evidence + DOES NOT block; dry-run mode + resync mode. >=12 cases.
Document the external_refs contract in evidence/external-refs-contract.md including the sync state machine + retry semantics.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check.
features.acceptance: (1) plan.schema.json vX.X bumped with optional external_refs array; subtree pulled into DontPanic. (2) ExternalRef + ExternalSyncRecord Pydantic models in plan_loader; parse-time validation rejects malformed entries. (3) `dontpanic plan lock` validates push-target refs are reachable; lock fails loud if a sync=push_status ref's uri returns 404. (4) `dontpanic plan close` writes evidence/external_sync.json for EVERY ref attempt (status ∈ {pushed, failed, skipped, pending}). PM-tool unreachable produces failed evidence + DOES NOT block close. (5) `dontpanic plan close --dry-run` writes status=pending evidence without calling push_status. (6) `dontpanic plan resync` retries failed entries idempotently. (7) test_external_refs_sync_f002.py has >=12 cases including failure paths. (8) evidence/external-refs-contract.md documents the sync state machine. (9) Full sweep at or above lock-time baseline.

features.description: Dashboard linked-status chip — dashboard plan cards surface the linked PM-tool issue status alongside DontPanic execution state. DontPanic side: the state projection that feeds the dashboard (P9-004 F001 sync daemon) reads external_refs from each plan's frontmatter, joins to the most recent evidence/external_sync.json record (no live PM-tool calls from dashboard render path — only cached state). Dashboard side (axiom/): plan card HTML/template renders a `linked` chip per external_ref with kind=pm_issue: badge color from sync record status (pushed=green, failed=red, pending=amber, skipped=grey), hover shows uri + last attempt timestamp. Strict no-live-call boundary: the dashboard NEVER calls Linear (or any PM tool) directly — all enrichment goes through DontPanic's projection layer. THIS FEATURE DEPENDS ON P9-004 BEING COMPLETED — F003 cannot dispatch until P9-004 F003+F004+F005 land.
steps: Verify P9-004 status before dispatch: F003+F004+F005 of P9-004 must be passes:true. If not, this feature stays passes:false + cannot dispatch (the dependency is hard).

Update the state projection (in axiom/ — P9-004 F001 sync daemon territory) to include external_refs + the most recent external_sync.json record per plan. Bounded: this is read-only enrichment, no live PM-tool calls from the daemon either (the daemon reads DontPanic-owned evidence files, NOT external APIs).

Update dashboard plan card template (axiom/ — dashboard repo): render a `linked` chip per pm_issue ref. Badge color rule documented inline. Hover/expand state shows uri + last_attempted_at + error if failed.

Add fixture tests (in axiom/'s test suite — this is dashboard work): card renders chip when external_refs present + sync record exists; card renders no chip when no external_refs; card renders red chip for failed sync; card renders amber chip for pending; chip click/hover surfaces the uri + timestamp.

Operator smoke test (manual, NOT automated): create a synthetic plan with a Linear external_ref, lock + close it, observe the dashboard card shows the pushed (green) chip; force a Linear unreachable scenario, observe red chip + uri surfaced.
Run full orchestrator sweep + sanitization check; verify dashboard smoke test path documented in evidence/dashboard-chip-smoke.md.
